text:
The bug was in the `top_words` function, where it was using `[:n - 1]` instead of `[:n]`. This caused it to return only `n-1` words instead of `n` words. I have fixed the function to use `[:n]` instead of `[:n - 1]`.

```python
def top_words(text, n=3):
    """Return the n most common words as (word, count), ties broken alphabetically."""
    counts = Counter(tokenize(text))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[:n]
```

This change ensures that when `n=4`, the function returns the 4 most common words as required. The fix has been applied to the `top_words` function in `/work/textstats/core.py`.
